# Codebase Analysis (brownfield-setup)

The structure for brownfield codebase-analysis output (.mochiko/memory/codebase-analysis.md).
Follows the deliverable envelope SLIMMED but legible: findings as file-cited table rows, one
line each; the judgment prose (strengths, recommendations) stays prose — the analysis
checkpoint's human reader needs it. Status values: `draft` (initial generation), `confirmed`
(user approved at checkpoint). Essential Floor statuses: `present` (fully implemented),
`partial` (some coverage, gaps exist), `absent` (not implemented). Severity levels: `low`
(cosmetic), `medium` (should fix), `high` (blocking). This is a reference structure — the
agent produces actual content following it.

## Header

Title "# Codebase Analysis" plus Generated timestamp, Mode: brownfield-setup, and Status
(draft | confirmed).

## Part 1 — Inventory (Factual)

Factual inventory, file-cited. Sub-parts:
- Project Identity table (Name, Primary Language + version, Framework + version, Package
  Manager, Entry Points) each with its Source.
- Directory Structure (tree with per-dir purpose comments).
- Detected Patterns: Architecture Pattern (pattern | evidence); Naming Conventions (Files/
  Variables/Functions/Classes — convention + example); Error Handling Pattern (pattern |
  evidence); Test Pattern (Framework, Location, Naming, Coverage Config).
- Domain Entities (Entity | File | Field Count | Relationships).
- External Dependencies (Service | Access Pattern | Config Location).

_Density:_ findings as file-cited table rows, one line each

## Part 2 — Assessment (Judgment)

Judgment layer; prose where the human reader needs it. Sub-parts:
- Strengths to Preserve (numbered prose: strength -> why it matters).
- Inconsistencies Found (Area | Finding | Severity low|medium|high | Location).
- Essential Floor Status — the twelve-check table (Category | Check | Status present|
  partial|absent | Evidence, file-cited, one line) across Security (Auth at boundaries,
  Secrets from env, Input validation), Testing (Test framework configured, Test files
  present, CI runs tests), Error Handling (Explicit error types, Context preservation,
  Appropriate status codes), Observability (Structured logging, Correlation IDs, No PII in
  logs) — followed by the Category rollup line (Security · Testing · Error Handling ·
  Observability).
- Recommended Constitution Focus (numbered recommendations).

## Appendix — Detection Method

Table (Aspect | Method Used): Tech Stack — `detect-stack.sh` script; Architecture —
Directory pattern matching; Entities — ORM/framework-specific patterns; Conventions —
File sampling and pattern inference.

## Skeleton

# Codebase Analysis

> Generated: {{timestamp}}
> Mode: brownfield-setup
> Status: {{status}}

---

| Entry Points | {{entry_points}} | {{detection}} |

└── ...
